div.div:
Keep SMB, VPN, HTTPS, and cloud onboarding as separate access profiles.
Native Air SMB is render-only: PF precedes share/service activation and no apply exists until rollback is atomic.
private-vpn-mtls terminates device certificates at Caddy while File Browser can stay on proxy-auth mode behind that edge.
Cloud onboarding checks local encryption + alias/backend only; provider enrollment is a separate online permission gate. Rclone performs no backend access, sync, mount, or deletion. Host-only secrets and reports stay out of commits.
